correctness.rationale: The left regular G-module has N/m cyclic regular H-modules under restriction to H=<g> of order m, because the left H-orbits are the RIGHT cosets Hx. Each m-th-root eigenvalue of g therefore has multiplicity N/m, identical to ∑dρ nullity of aI+bρ(g)* at resonance −a/b. Nonresonance gives rank N, and Cauchy’s theorem supplies the least-order p sharp two-point minimum. Caught and corrected a concrete source proof nomenclature bug: original RESULT.md incorrectly called Hx “left cosets”; the corrected complete RESULT.md says “right cosets Hx”, preserving all statement/proof/scope elsewhere. No direct numerical test substitutes for the exact representation restriction.
